title: a signed-out visitor sees that something is happening, and is asked in to read it

criteria.text: An anonymous caller cannot retrieve an announcement body from the database, by any route
criteria.note: `page_posts` has no anonymous read (`to authenticated`); `announcements_withheld` has no body in its return type [V migration 20261016150052, 20260923161500]. Checked: `tests/announcements-signed-out-rest.test.ts` `[guards F093.1]` asks PostgREST with the publishable key; #218 records it failing on the pre-migration database [V PR body]. Reviewed no: #218 carries no `Reviewed by:` line [V]. Shipped: deploy-health success on 75c682a8 [V]. Smoked unknown: the withheld read changed again in #815 (15:19 UTC today), after the last green smoke, and the smoke does not call PostgREST.

criteria.text: The same is true of the start time and the place, and of any later column that carries them
criteria.note: Same policy; the return type has no `starts_at` or `location_id` [V]. `[guards F093.2]` selects `starts_at, location_id` as anon and expects no rows; the exact-column allow-list under F093.3 covers later columns [V]. Reviewed no (#218 has no `Reviewed by:`); shipped 75c682a8 success. No mutant run is recorded for this one (see #844).

criteria.text: Withholding is enforced in SQL: a projection that never selects the body, not a filter
criteria.note: `announcements_withheld` returns nine columns: result_id, group_id, slug, name, public_id, photo_url, announcement_count, announcement_ids, updated_at [V migration 20261016150052]. `[guards F093.3]` asserts that exact key set, keys and not nulls; it was watched failing in #230 [V PR body]. Reviewed no (#218, #230 carry no `Reviewed by:`); shipped yes (75c682a8, 19109a1e, b7766901 all deploy-health success).

criteria.text: The signed-out card carries exactly five things; a Page with no or a hidden photo shows its kind's default image
criteria.note: Built half: photo, name, count with its period, the details line and the sign-in call, with no body, time, place or Page location [V `WithheldAnnouncementCard.tsx`]. Missing: the kind's default art. The card calls `artKindFor(result.groupKind)` and `mapWithheldRow` sets `groupKind: ''`, so a no-photo or hidden-photo card is a plain tile with no icon [V]. #335 (open, Beta 11-06, not labelled launch-blocking). Checked no: `[guards F093.4]` in `tests/f093-withheld-card-criteria.test.tsx` marks the whole criterion but asserts only that a `default-art` element exists, not its kind, so it passes while the kind is missing.

criteria.text: One card per Page, with the count and its period in words; a Page with none this period keeps its card without a nought
criteria.note: One row per Page (#230); label "N posts this week", zero reads "A new post" [V withheld-copy.ts]. `[guards F093.5]` (`tests/f093-withheld-card-criteria.test.tsx`) checks both against real rows, seen failing against mutants (#769) [V PR body]. Reviewed no: #218, #230 have no `Reviewed by:`; shipped yes (75c682a8, 19109a1e). Smoked unknown: the withheld read changed in #815 after the last green smoke.

criteria.text: A signed-in member sees no change whatsoever
criteria.note: `[guards F093.6]` in `tests/f093-front-door-guards.test.tsx` reads bodies, times, places, tags and order as a signed-in member through the real Page and Explore loaders and expects no withheld card; seen failing against 8 mutants (#770) [V]. Reviewed no (#218, #255); shipped yes (75c682a8, a7814ce9). Smoked yes: smoke-live run 38920035175 on 7f38b45b (2026-10-16, routes explore, page, you, all personas) was green and is after the last merge that built this [V]. Caveat: Explore for members has since changed on purpose (#800, #815); this scenario's claim is about its own change only.

criteria.text: Signed-out Explore still contains post-kind rows, in withheld form
criteria.note: `loadBrowse` merges `getWithheldAnnouncements` into signed-out results (#218) [V load.ts]. Since #800 (Don, 2026-10-14) the default Explore view lists Pages only; a signed-out Page that posted since the last visit leads as its withheld card, and all withheld cards show under the Updates view [V lead.ts, BrowseSurface.tsx]. Don's 2026-10-16 comments on #796 say Explore mixes everything by default again; not built [V]. Checked no: `[guards F093.7]` in `load-withheld.test.ts` asserts the loader snapshot, not the screen, so it stays green while the default view hides the rows. #844. Reviewed no (#218); shipped yes (75c682a8, 24891b70).

criteria.text: Signed-out front door: name, photo, description and the withheld card; no location, tags or founder; no map pins; indexable
criteria.note: `anon` loses `locations`, `anchor_location_id`, `page_tags`, `tags`; `browse_feed` returns null location, empty tags and no geography signed out; `robots.ts` admits search crawlers (#255, #259) [V]. `[guards F093.8]` in `tests/f093-front-door-guards.test.tsx` renders a signed-out Page and Explore card against real rows, plus `front-door-db.test.ts` and `member-reads-audit-db.test.ts` [V]. Button reads "Sign in to see what's happening" per the 2026-10-04 ruling (placeholder copy). Reviewed no (#255, #259 carry no `Reviewed by:`). Shipped unknown: no deploy-health run for 73625848 (#259) [V]. Smoked yes: run 38920035175, signed-out persona, explore and page.

criteria.text: An #announcement-<id> link, to any of the Page's announcements, lands on a page that resolves with the one card marked
criteria.note: `WithheldPagePosts` carries an anchor per announcement id; the database returns all ids for a Page (#230) [V]. `[guards F093.9]` renders the Page for the latest and an older id, expects one marked card with the sign-in call, no 404; seen failing against mutants (#769) [V]. Reviewed no (#230); shipped yes (19109a1e); smoked yes (run 38920035175 opens page signed out; it does not follow an anchor).

criteria.text: Nothing on the signed-out surface is a link to a body; the ask comes first
criteria.note: The sign-in call is its own link to `/auth/login?next=<Page>`; the card link goes only to the Page [V `WithheldAnnouncementCard.tsx`]. `[guards F093.10]` collects every link on the signed-out Explore card and Page card and matches them against Page or sign-in only; seen failing against mutants (#769) [V]. Reviewed no (#218, #230); shipped yes; smoked yes (as 9).

criteria.text: The card is the same for every anonymous reader
criteria.note: Nothing on the withheld path reads a cookie, header, storage, clock or place [V]. `[guards F093.11]` renders for two readers with different headers, timezones and cookies and expects identical output, and scans the four path files for per-reader reads; seen failing against mutants (#770) [V]. Reviewed no (#218, #230); shipped yes; smoked yes.

criteria.text: Every criterion is discharged by a check that has been observed failing
criteria.note: Fail-first is recorded for 1 (#218), 3 (#230), 4, 5, 9, 10 (#769 mutants) and 6, 8, 11 (#770 mutants) [V PR bodies]. None is recorded for 2 or 7, and 4's check cannot fail on the missing kind art. `scripts/probe-anon-announcements.sh` is not run by CI [A]. #844 (7, 12); 4 waits on #335.
